title: Test-discovery precision: exact commands, verifiers assert nonzero count
subject: test-discovery-precision
ratio:
**Test-discovery precision (P-025)**: acceptance criteria MUST carry the exact,
layout-matching test command — not a generic invocation that silently discovers zero
tests against a mismatched file layout. Verifiers MUST assert a **nonzero executed-test
count** before trusting a green run; exit 0 alone is not evidence.
dicta:
Precedent this
codifies: a bare `node --test` returned exit 0 with 0 tests executed against the
cronsplain `tests/test_*.js` layout (node's default discovery pattern doesn't match it)
— a false-green a less careful verifier could have rubber-stamped; the corrected,
layout-matching criterion command is `node --test tests/*.js` (T-044/T-052 join note,
`events.jsonl`).
scope_conditions: role:thinker or role:coordinator drafting acceptance_criteria test commands for any task in any epic
role:verifier evaluating any test-suite run before marking a task done
revisit_trigger: Revisit if a bare-discovery false-green (exit 0, 0 tests executed) recurs after this rule shipped, or a verifier is shown accepting a green run without checking the executed-test count.
validity_conditions: the substrate test suite runs via python3 -m unittest discover -s .harness/tests
